subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Elder Financial Abuse
description: A quick, practical guide to Elder Financial Abuse.

hook.text: A caregiver drains a 90-year-old's life savings through power of attorney. The family finds out too late.

buildup.text: Elder financial abuse costs seniors over $28 billion annually. Perpetrators are often family or trusted aides.

discovery.text: Only 1 in 44 cases is reported. Victims are often isolated, cognitively impaired, or dependent on the abuser.

twist.text: Banks are training staff to spot signs: unusual withdrawals, new 'friends,' and sudden changes in financial behavior.

climax.text: Protecting elders requires coordination between banks, social services, and families. Most systems fail.

punchline.text: $28 billion stolen from seniors. 1 in 44 cases reported.
